listening.title: A discovery meeting with a logistics company

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Executive)
lines.text: Thank you for your time, Mr. Tuấn. Before I show you anything, I'd like to understand your business better.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Operations Director)
lines.text: Sure. We're a logistics company with about two hundred drivers in the south.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Executive)
lines.text: Could you walk me through how you plan delivery routes today?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Operations Director)
lines.text: Our planners use spreadsheets every morning. It takes them about three hours.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Executive)
lines.text: I see. And what happens when a route plan is late?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Operations Director)
lines.text: Drivers wait at the warehouse, and customers complain about late deliveries. That's the real problem.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Executive)
lines.text: That's very helpful. Are you working with an existing vendor for any of this?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Operations Director)
lines.text: We use a GPS tracking tool, but the contract ends in January.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Executive)
lines.text: So would a go-live date in January make sense? And do you have a rough budget in mind?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Operations Director)
lines.text: January would be ideal. For budget, I need to talk to our finance director first.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Account Executive)
lines.text: Of course. Last question: what would success look like for you in six months?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Operations Director)
lines.text: Route planning in under thirty minutes and fewer customer complaints.

questions.q: How do Tuấn's planners plan routes today?

options: Drivers wait and deliveries are late
The GPS tool is too expensive

questions.q: Why can't Tuấn give a budget yet?
options: He doesn't want to buy anything
He needs to talk to the finance director
